titolo: Google launches Gemini Decisions API with fast multimodal decision model
descr: Gemini Decision 1 processes up to 1,000 closed‑set questions in a single pass, costing $0.10 per million input tokens.
paragrafi: Google DeepMind announced the Gemini Decisions API, powered by the new Gemini Decision 1 model.
The model can evaluate up to 1,000 yes/no, multiple‑choice, or rubric‑scoring questions in a single forward pass across text, images, audio, video and PDFs.
Latency is reported at 150‑250 ms end‑to‑end, and pricing is $0.10 per million input tokens with no charge for output tokens.
Gemini Decision 1 leads benchmark suites in agent routing, reasoning and multimodal understanding, achieving the lowest calibration error.
Google says internal teams already use the API for dynamic model routing in Gemini Notebook, rapid design prototyping in Stitch, and safety checks in Search.
perche: The API offers developers a cheap, low‑latency way to make probabilistic decisions without token‑by‑token generation, useful for routing, grading or policy checks. While Google’s paid Gemini 4 Carbon tops FreeLLMArena’s paid model list, free‑tier users may still prefer open models such as Kimi K3 or GLM‑5.3, which remain the top‑ranked free chat options.
